label: EdgeRouter 4
description: Ubiquiti EdgeRouter 4 - 3x 10/100/1000 RJ45 + 1x 1G SFP (eth3). AC-powered, no PoE. 13 W max.
notes: Ubiquiti sources read 2026-11-19: tech-spec page https://techspecs.ui.com/uisp/wired/er-4 (200, 575,010 B) and store page https://store.ui.com/us/en/products/er-4 (200, 323,081 B), which print the same table. **Networking interface (3) 10/100/1000 RJ45 ports, (1) 1 Gbps SFP port; Management interface (1) RJ45 serial port (4) Ethernet ports; Power method Universal AC power cord (C13), 30W; Power supply Internal AC/DC power adapter; Supported voltage range 100-240V AC; Max. power consumption 13W.** No PoE anywhere: the page has no PoE row at all, so the three copper ports are declared `poeIn: false` rather than left to the engine's PD guess - an AC only router cannot be powered down a cable. No datasheet: dl.ui.com/datasheets/edgemax/EdgeRouter_4_DS.pdf answers 200 with the 609,911-byte tech-specs front page, so every figure above is tech-spec-only. The store page corroborates; its `PoE` rows are absent, not empty.
